findings.note: Roll call 139 on the House voting bill H.4359: the roll call lists Day as voting N; amendment passed 32 yeas, 126 nays, so it failed. Amendment 7 (filed by Rep. Frost, titled 'Voter Identification' on the bill's amendments page https://malegislature.gov/Bills/192/H4359/Amendments) would require valid state or federal photo ID at the polls, with challenge or provisional ballot and 8-business-day cure for voters without ID, and a free-ID indigency waiver.
